title: Ex-Google Recruiter Explains: The AI Mistakes Making You Look Junior
description:
Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now
 Book a 1:1: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs

My Job Seeker Toolkit gives you everything you need to finally get callbacks, from resume to offer.

As a former Google recruiter, I’ve seen how poor communication, not poor performance, is what holds most professionals back. 

In this video, I break down the most common mistake people make with AI tools like ChatGPT, and how it quietly undermines how strategic you look at work. 

Drawing from my background in tech and recruiting, I share actionable strategies to structure your prompts so your AI output finally reflects the level you're already operating at.
